Tavus Grimenridge followed her to Larkby within the month (Chapter 19 | ¶3528). Thiric Ashner died of a kick from a cart horse at the churchyard at Kelby (Chapter 6 | ¶1911). Therefore, Tavus Grimenridge was living in Larkby at the time Thiric Ashner died.

Answer: Larkby.

Kara Corrley was living in Harrowton at the time Aeric Lindick died.  
Answer: Harrowton.

Mabin Ashner is married to Coena Brackwood.  
Answer: Coena Brackwood.

The oak map belonged to Aeric Lindick, head of the Lindick household. According to the record, the oak map always passed, on the death of whoever held it, to the eldest living child of that holder. There is no information about who holds the oak map at the end of the record. 

Answer: unknown
Answer: The husband of Lulde Stenenridge.

The copper flute was held by Malan Stenenridge immediately before its current holder.  
Answer: Malan Stenenridge.

Thilis Stenenridge was born in Duncombe.  
Answer: Duncombe.
The record does not mention where Aeric Lindick was born. Answer: unknown.

The record never specifies where Wemor Grimenridge was born.  
Answer: unknown

Mabin Marrworth was born at Brynby.  
Answer: Brynby.

Jovus Orlick was born in Wendmere.  
Answer: Wendmere.

Neena Ashner was born at Kelwick.  
Answer: Kelwick.

Ilbin Marrworth was born at Wendhaven.  
Answer: Wendhaven.
